definitions.explanation: Romantic or sexual involvement with someone other than one's partner. Can refer to the act itself or the tendency toward such behavior.
A changeable, inconstant nature. Being easily attracted to new things and quickly losing interest. Less common than sense 1 in modern usage.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly refers to romantic infidelity (sense 1). As a suru verb: {浮気|うわき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to cheat, to have an affair). As a na-adjective: {浮気|うわき}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a fickle/unfaithful person).

The compound {浮気|うわき}⟦{性|しょう}→〜性：28334_shou⟧ describes someone who is habitually unfaithful or fickle by nature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {浮気|うわき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cheat, to have an affair
- {浮気|うわき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ばれる→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧: for cheating to be discovered
- {浮気|うわき}⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧: the person one is having an affair with
- {浮気|うわき}⟦{性|しょう}→〜性：28334_shou⟧: fickle/unfaithful nature
- {浮気|うわき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{疑|うたが}う→疑う：01889_utagau⟧: to suspect infidelity
